annotation.interpretation_a: Expert reviewers may reject any registration that is unrelated to the corresponding registry and whose value conflicts with the value in that registry.
annotation.interpretation_b: Expert reviewers may reject registrations that are unrelated to each other (i.e., not related to other registrations) if they conflict with the same value in the corresponding registry.
annotation.justification: The lack of a clear definition for 'unrelated registrations' creates a concrete missing constraint that allows two materially different interpretations of which registrations may be rejected.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not define what 'unrelated registrations' means, leading to different possible implementation behaviours.
